title: As a Deer Pants for Flowing Streams

questions.question: As a deer pants for flowing streams, so pants my soul for whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 42:1 (ESV): "As a deer pants for flowing streams, so pants my soul for you, O God."

questions.question: My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When shall I come and appear before whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 42:2 (ESV): "My soul thirsts for God, for the living God. When shall I come and appear before God?"

questions.question: My tears have been my food when?
questions.explanation: Psalm 42:3 (ESV): "My tears have been my food day and night,"

questions.question: Why are you cast down, O my soul, and why are you in turmoil within me? Hope in whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 42:5 (ESV): "...Hope in God; for I shall again praise him, my salvation"

questions.question: Deep calls to deep at the roar of your what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 42:7 (ESV): "Deep calls to deep at the roar of your waterfalls;"

questions.question: By day the Lord commands his steadfast love, and at night his what is with me?
questions.explanation: Psalm 42:8 (ESV): "...and at night his song is with me,"

questions.question: I say to God, my rock: "Why have you forgotten me? Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the what?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 42:9 (ESV): "...Why do I go mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?"

questions.question: As with a deadly wound in my bones, my adversaries taunt me, while they say to me all the day long, "Where is your what?"
questions.explanation: Psalm 42:10 (ESV): "...while they say to me all the day long, 'Where is your God?'"

questions.question: These things I remember, as I pour out my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 42:4 (ESV): "These things I remember, as I pour out my soul:"

questions.question: How I would go with the throng and lead them in procession to the house of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 42:4 (ESV): "...lead them in procession to the house of God with glad shouts..."

questions.question: Who are the Sons of Korah mentioned in the title?
questions.explanation: The Sons of Korah were a guild of temple singers/musicians.

questions.question: From the land of Jordan and of Hermon, from Mount Mizar, I remember whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 42:6 (ESV): "...therefore I remember you from the land of Jordan and of Hermon, from Mount Mizar."

questions.question: All your breakers and your waves have gone over whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 42:7 (ESV): "all your breakers and your waves have gone over me."

questions.question: Hope in God; for I shall again praise him, my salvation and my what?
This Psalm is a Maskil of whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 42 Title: "To the choirmaster. A Maskil of the Sons of Korah."

key_verse_text: As a deer pants for flowing streams, so pants my soul for you, O God.
